variants.headline: A company goes under
variants.body: A company has gone under in {colony}. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.

variants.headline: Business failure enters the colony's record
variants.body: The colony has seen a company fail. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.

variants.headline: An enterprise reaches failure
variants.body: A business in the colony has gone under. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.
